# Fate UI v0.9.2-beta1

This prerelease adds attested agent writes, a wider voice model catalog with live multilingual input, and a leaner main process.

## Added

- Agent write attestations: every successful write or edit lands in a bounded, local, per-project ledger. A new Activity tab shows those records beside live runtime events.
- Six named voice models in three tiers: Mini (Canary 180M Flash), Balanced (Parakeet Unified EN live, Nemotron 3.5 Streaming live with 28 languages, Parakeet TDT v3 with 25 European languages), and Max (Cohere Transcribe with the lowest error rate, Whisper large-v3-turbo with 99 languages).
- Live multilingual voice input with automatic language detection.
- Prompt polish in the composer: rewrite a draft before sending it.
- Optional final accuracy pass for voice input, off by default.
- Background duration lookups for queued music tracks.
- A `docs/` guide set covering features, orchestration, sessions, architecture, themes, and development.

## Changed

- Live voice input warns at five seconds of backlog, keeps every transcribed word when it fails, and finalizes cleanly at a three-minute cap instead of erroring. Silence is filtered before decoding.
- Speech settings are grouped by tier, with live badges on streaming models.
- The main process is split into focused bootstrap, window, update, and speech modules, with a multi-window launch dispatcher.
- The macOS update install logic moved into its own tested module.
- The README is shorter; the detail moved into the docs guides.

## Removed

- The old tier-based voice model ids (`mini`, `balanced`, `max` as model ids). Saved settings migrate automatically to the new model ids.

## Fixed

- The e2e harness now stubs the new music duration sink and prompt optimization runtime methods (test-only).

## Verification

- Local validation: TypeScript typecheck, 143 Vitest files / 1332 tests, e2e suite 4/4, and production build passed.
- GitHub Actions run [31817099318](https://github.com/Master0fFate/pi-fategui/actions/runs/31817099318) passed on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. Each platform built, installed, and smoked its artifacts.

## Notes

- Public beta installers are unsigned. Verify each download against the `SHA256SUMS` file shipped with the release.
